content: Standard Flutter Clean Architecture layout is layer-first: lib/features/<feature>/{data,domain,presentation}, each with data/{datasources,models,repositories_impl}, domain/{entities,repositories,usecases}, presentation/{cubit,pages,widgets}. get_it as service locator registered in injection_container.dart/injectable, Cubit depends only on UseCases (never Repository or DataSource directly), UseCase depends only on abstract Repository interface (domain layer), concrete Repository impl (data layer) depends on DataSource + NetworkInfo and returns Either<Failure, Entity>.
